purpose: Create a source-group-disjoint Train-only OOF baseline and test whether lexical features offer a robust complementary signal.
folds: 5 deterministic greedy multilabel-balanced folds; sourceGroupId is indivisible; seed/hash tie breaking fixed
features: word TF-IDF (1-2 grams, min_df=2, sublinear_tf) plus character TF-IDF (3-5 grams, min_df=2, sublinear_tf), max 60000 each
classifier: 18 independent LogisticRegression classifiers, C=2, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=2000
decision: fixed probability >=0.5, retain at most two highest probabilities
selection: No hyperparameter/threshold/fold sweep. Continue only if OOF Macro-F1 >=0.35 and all 18 labels have nonzero F1.
